description: Contoso is migrating claims processing from two on-premises data centers to Azure. The target must preserve private connectivity for SQL backends, support blue/green cutover, and honor retention policies. Review proposed hub-spoke topology, identity, and data paths for gaps before executive approval.
constraints: No public ingress to transactional SQL
Private Link for PaaS data planes
Encryption in transit and at rest
RPO under 15 minutes for core workflows
requiredCapabilities: Azure Application Gateway or Front Door
assumptions: Single primary Azure region with DR region limited to warm standby
securityBaselineHints: Secrets in Azure Key Vault only
